title: a says /a/
parentNote: Today is one letter and one sound: a says /a/, the sound at the start of "apple". Say the sound, never the letter name — "ay" is the name, and a child who learns names first has to unlearn them before they can sound out a single word. Day one is short on purpose; five happy minutes beats twenty tired ones.

activities.mouthCue: Open your mouth wide, like the doctor is looking in. /a/.
activities.prompt: This is the very first sound. It says…
These three look alike. Which one says /a/?
Here it is again. What does it say?
